“Theydies and Gentlethems of Empire City we have had an eventful weekend. This is your host Finn Midask here with the truth.

Friday evening we found Champ, a baby Kraken in the harbor outside Ferrytown getting attacked by several Dorba-chu creatures.

Yesterday in the evening we experienced several difficulties with a werewolf hunt transpiring. It is unknown if any may still be out there, but please contact your clerical care provider if you experience any sudden hair growth or rage.

Today we find ourselves with forward news of a predicament. We have received word of redcoat snipers setting up around the Noir to take out valued targets. Arm yourselves and be ready. Locations will be shared at the Samuel Adams by map. They strike tonight and we must rally and be ready.

At 4pm feel free to meet at The Golden Voice in order to prepare yourself. I will give a briefing and prepare you for the fight to come! We’ll organize and show them not to mess with our city!

And now for the weather. Be wary of floating clouds of darkness in Manhattan. They seem to be obscuring unlucky guests for an hour. Ferrytown has been subjected to redcoat interference making everything 10% more expensive to purchase there. 

Additionally, Kingsbridge is having issues with Faerie fire spraying onto all newcomers walking about. If you don’t want to get caught down and easily spotted for an hour, either avoid it or make sure you’re prepared to dodge the fleeting strands of magic.

Until next time folks, this is Finn Midask with the Truth, signing off”
